note: invented demo conversation (Bram, Ilse, Noor, Tomasz); no benchmark text

turns.speaker: Bram
turns.text: I finally moved to Utrecht last week.

turns.speaker: Ilse
turns.text: Congratulations! Are you still working at the bakery?

turns.speaker: Bram
turns.text: Yes, I bake sourdough at Korenbloem every morning.

turns.speaker: Ilse
turns.text: I started cello lessons with Noor's teacher.

turns.speaker: Bram
turns.text: Noor? Our friend Noor, the one we call Nono?

turns.speaker: Ilse
turns.text: That's the one. Nono recommended the teacher.

turns.speaker: Bram
turns.text: Tomasz asked me to join the Sunday hike with the climbing club.

turns.speaker: Ilse
turns.text: Which Sunday?

turns.speaker: Bram
turns.text: The twelfth of May, if the weather holds.

turns.speaker: Ilse
turns.text: She said the forecast looks fine.

turns.speaker: Noor
turns.text: Hi both, Nono here with news: I adopted a greyhound called Pepper.

turns.speaker: Bram
turns.text: Pepper is a great name! I adopted nothing, but I bought a bicycle.

turns.speaker: Ilse
turns.text: Bram bought a red bicycle at the market on Vrijdag.

turns.speaker: Noor
turns.text: Ilse, how is the cello going?

turns.speaker: Ilse
turns.text: I play Bach suites now and I practise every evening.

turns.speaker: Tomasz
turns.text: Bram, correction on the hike: it is the nineteenth of May, not the twelfth.

turns.speaker: Bram
turns.text: Thanks Tomasz, nineteenth then.

turns.speaker: Tomasz
turns.text: Also I now run the bakery on Mondays, so ask me about shifts.

turns.speaker: Noor
turns.text: He loved it.

turns.speaker: Ilse
turns.text: Noor, bring Pepper to the hike if she is allowed.

turns.speaker: Bram
turns.text: The hike was wonderful, we reached the ridge by noon.

turns.speaker: Ilse
turns.text: I left the bakery job and now I teach cello at a school.

turns.speaker: Noor
turns.text: Ilse changed jobs? I thought she was a translator.

turns.speaker: Ilse
turns.text: I was a translator until January, then I moved to teaching.

turns.speaker: Bram
turns.text: I quit the bakery too. I now work at a cycle shop called Spaakwerk.

turns.speaker: Tomasz
turns.text: Sad to lose you, Bram. Who will bake the sourdough?

turns.speaker: Bram
turns.text: Tomasz, Noor offered to cover the sourdough.

turns.speaker: Noor
turns.text: Pepper met a hedgehog in the garden yesterday.

turns.speaker: Ilse
turns.text: We are all meeting at Noor's on the fifteenth of June.

turns.speaker: Tomasz
turns.text: I will bring the rye bread.
